doc.md:
Displays an icon-size spinning animation.

It is often used as an alternative to a [`ProgressBar`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ProgressBar)
for displaying indefinite activity, instead of actual progress.

To start the animation, use [`Spinner.start()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Spinner#method:start), to stop it
use [`Spinner.stop()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Spinner#method:stop).

# CSS nodes

`GtkSpinner` has a single CSS node with the name spinner.
When the animation is active, the :checked pseudoclass is
added to this node.

# Accessibility

`GtkSpinner` uses the [`AccessibleRole.progress_bar`](xref:gtk:Gtk.AccessibleRole#value:progress_bar) role.
